description: Search 10k+ live cybersecurity jobs from 246 security companies, plus salary benchmarks and stats.
summary: Search 10k+ live cybersecurity jobs from 246 security companies, plus salary benchmarks and stats.
offersHint: Search 10k+ live cybersecurity jobs from 246 security companies, plus salary benchmarks and stats. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.infosecjobboard.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_jobs
toolsPreview.description: Search live cybersecurity jobs from 200+ security companies (updated hourly). Returns up to 10 matching roles plus the total match count and a browse URL for the full list. All Apply flows go through the returned job URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get_job
toolsPreview.description: Get one job by id: role details, a short description excerpt, and the canonical job-page URL (which is also where to apply).

toolsPreview.name: salary_benchmark
toolsPreview.description: Curated cybersecurity salary benchmark bands (USD + local currency) across 21 countries including the US, EU, Gulf (tax-free), India, LatAm, and Africa.

toolsPreview.name: market_stats
toolsPreview.description: Live aggregate cybersecurity hiring stats: total open security roles, new this week, remote share, salary-disclosure rate, and top specializations / seniorities / countries.

toolsPreview.name: top_employers
toolsPreview.description: The security companies with the most open cybersecurity roles right now (objective open-roles ranking with remote share and pay-transparency rate).
